sec-form4-insiders.title: SEC Form 4 Insider Trades to JSON
sec-form4-insiders.seoTitle: SEC Form 4 Insider Trades API - Buys & Sells as JSON
sec-form4-insiders.description: Fetch recent SEC Form 4 insider filings for any US ticker and get clean JSON: insider, role, transaction code, shares, price, dollar value, holdings after, plus buy-vs-sell summary. Public EDGAR data, built for AI agents and research.

event.name: filing-parsed
event.title: Filing parsed
event.description: Charged once per Form 4 filing fetched and parsed

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: US stock tickers, e.g. AAPL, MSFT

filingsPerTicker.title: Filings per ticker
filingsPerTicker.description: How many recent Form 4 filings to fetch per ticker (1-20)

contactEmail.title: Your contact email (optional)
contactEmail.description: SEC asks callers to identify themselves; if set it is sent in the User-Agent header to sec.gov

code.title: Code
code.description: SEC transaction code: P=open-market purchase, S=open-market sale, M=option exercise, A=award, G=gift, F=tax withholding

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: Number of shares in the transaction

pricePerShare.title: Price per share
pricePerShare.description: Price per share in USD (0 if not reported)

valueUsd.title: Value (USD)
valueUsd.description: shares x price, rounded to cents

error.title: Error
error.description: Set only if a ticker could not be processed

sec-form4-insiders.seoDescription: Get SEC Form 4 insider buys and sells for any US ticker as clean JSON: insider, role, shares, price, value. No API key. Built for traders and AI agents.

sec-13f-holdings.title: SEC 13F Institutional Holdings and Quarter Diffs
sec-13f-holdings.seoTitle: SEC 13F Holdings API - Institutional Positions as JSON
sec-13f-holdings.description: Get any institutional filer's latest SEC 13F holdings as clean JSON and see which positions were added, exited, increased or decreased versus the prior quarter. Public EDGAR data for AI agents and research.

event.name: position-returned
event.title: Position returned
event.description: Charged once per holding row returned

ciks.title: Filer CIKs
ciks.description: SEC CIK numbers of 13F filers (e.g. 1067983 for Berkshire Hathaway)

maxRowsPerFiler.title: Max rows per filer
maxRowsPerFiler.description: Cap on rows returned (and charged) per filer

compareWithPreviousQuarter.title: Compare with previous quarter
compareWithPreviousQuarter.description: Show new/exited/increased/decreased positions vs the prior filing

contactEmail.title: Your contact email (optional)
contactEmail.description: Sent in the User-Agent header to sec.gov as SEC requests

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.description: Name of the issuer of the held security

status.title: Status
status.description: new / exited / increased / decreased / unchanged versus the prior quarter, or current when not comparing

previousShares.title: Previous shares
previousShares.description: Shares held in the prior quarter

currentShares.title: Current shares
currentShares.description: Shares held in the latest quarter

pctChange.title: % change
pctChange.description: Percent change in shares (null when there was no prior position)

valueUsd.title: Value (USD)
valueUsd.description: Reported market value of the position

error.title: Error
error.description: Set only if a filer could not be processed

sec-13f-holdings.seoDescription: SEC 13F holdings for any fund as clean JSON, plus quarter-over-quarter new, exited, increased and decreased positions. No API key. For investors and AI agents.

treasury-yield-curve.title: US Treasury Yield Curve to JSON
treasury-yield-curve.seoTitle: US Treasury Yield Curve API - Daily Rates as JSON
treasury-yield-curve.description: Daily US Treasury par yield curve rates as clean JSON with 2s10s spread, inversion flag and day-over-day changes. Public U.S. Treasury data for AI agents and macro research.

event.name: day-returned
event.title: Day returned
event.description: Charged once per trading day of curve data returned

year.title: Year
year.description: Calendar year of curve data (defaults to the current year)

maxDays.title: Max days
maxDays.description: Most recent N trading days to return

1M.title: 1M yield
1M.description: Par yield for the 1M tenor, in percent

2M.title: 2M yield
2M.description: Par yield for the 2M tenor, in percent

3M.title: 3M yield
3M.description: Par yield for the 3M tenor, in percent

4M.title: 4M yield
4M.description: Par yield for the 4M tenor, in percent

6M.title: 6M yield
6M.description: Par yield for the 6M tenor, in percent

1Y.title: 1Y yield
1Y.description: Par yield for the 1Y tenor, in percent

2Y.title: 2Y yield
2Y.description: Par yield for the 2Y tenor, in percent

3Y.title: 3Y yield
3Y.description: Par yield for the 3Y tenor, in percent

5Y.title: 5Y yield
5Y.description: Par yield for the 5Y tenor, in percent

7Y.title: 7Y yield
7Y.description: Par yield for the 7Y tenor, in percent

10Y.title: 10Y yield
10Y.description: Par yield for the 10Y tenor, in percent

20Y.title: 20Y yield
20Y.description: Par yield for the 20Y tenor, in percent

30Y.title: 30Y yield
30Y.description: Par yield for the 30Y tenor, in percent

signals.title: Curve signals
signals.description: 2s10s spread, inversion flag and change versus the previous day

error.title: Error
error.description: Set only if no data was returned

treasury-yield-curve.seoDescription: US Treasury daily yield curve as clean JSON with 2s10s spread, inversion flag and daily changes. No API key. For macro research and AI agents.
